lea.text: The Phyrexians' black mana corrupted Serra's Realm and drove Serra away, which led to Radiant's coup while Urza evacuated some angels to Dominaria.

leb.text: After Urza left, the Phyrexians attacked Serra's Realm; they were repelled, but their black mana tainted the Realm, and Serra proposed an exodus and fled.

uds.text: The Phyrexians created the plane of Rath as a staging ground for their invasion.
They launched a preemptive strike on project sites, killing thousands including Sisay's parents, though Karn carried Gerrard to safety in Jamuura.
In Urza's own invasion of Serra's Realm, Barrin battled the Phyrexian overlord.

pcy.text: At the Keldon Necropolis, Eladamri and Astor's armies made a stand against the Phyrexians.
Phyrexian necromancy raised the Keldon dead as thralls, until Tajamin hurled the cudgel down, melting the glacier and flooding the battlefield.

fut.text: Phyrexian horrors crossed into the present through a temporal rift, which Freyalise closed by giving her spark and her life.
Elsewhere, Mirrodin fell to the Phyrexians and became New Phyrexia.

som.text: The Phyrexians took and altered some of the myr, and Phyrexian corruption upset the balance of the six Vulshok forge tribes, causing civil war.
Venser and Koth were captured in the Mephidross and brought to the Phyrexian lair at Ish Sah, until Koth escaped and Elspeth killed the Phyrexians and freed Venser.
Each color alignment gained a Praetor, which factionalized the Phyrexians, and the destruction of Mirran culture left the Vulshok functionally extinct.

mbs.text: As the Phyrexian contagion corroded Karn's body, the praetors whispered psalms to corrupt his mind.
Elspeth and her companions fought Phyrexian butchers and escaped through a meat shaft, and Elspeth slew every Phyrexian in a surgery room, freeing Melira.
Many angels fought and died resisting Phyrexia on Mirrodin, and several were captured and compleated.

nph.text: The Phyrexians took over the plane and drove the Mirrans into hiding, breaking Mirrans down and rebuilding them as loyal servants of the force they had fought.
They split into five factions, each led by a praetor, and Elesh Norn's white-aligned faction subdued the rest and became Mother of Machines.
Only pockets of Mirran resistance remained, and the plane was renamed New Phyrexia.
Later a coalition defeated the Phyrexians and New Phyrexia switched places with Zhalfir.

dmu.text: On Dominaria, Karn found living Phyrexian cables embedded in the rock, and when he tore one free the cave-in destroyed his workshop.
At a peace summit, three Benalish knights burst open into Phyrexian monsters, and the group could no longer trust anyone.
Liliana raised the dead of a swamp against a Phyrexian team led by Elas il-Kor, and later defeated another Phyrexian group at the Vess estate.
Sleeper agents were exposed even at a school, where Brotten's face split to reveal a Phyrexian chasing Ulf until a swordsman killed five more agents.

mom.text: The Phyrexians' invasion spread across the Multiverse, with Phyrexian forces raining onto Theros and the invasion spines descending onto Kaladesh.
On New Capenna, the corrupted angel Atraxa began scouring the city, and on Ixalan a branch of Realmbreaker split the sky and the Phyrexians ended the emperor's war.
Vraska was compleated and led the Phyrexians into the Golgari undercity, transforming her people, while Nahiri, also compleated, planned to use the Emeria Skyclave to connect the hedron networks.
Defenders fought back, from the Amonkheti defense, bolstered by the ancient dead, to the tide of the dead that Gisa raised on Innistrad, while Sea Gate fell.
